acquisitions.access_limit: The 24247801-byte ZIP duplicates the exact JPEG streams already retained in the 23705230-byte 40-page PDF. It is remote solely to avoid retaining a second approximately 24 MB representation of those same image bytes. Its exact bytes are reconstructible offline from the retained PDF using Poppler pdfimages, the retained index and holding-library manifest, and the retained rebuild-source-selection.py recipe. The recipe verifies every member and the final ZIP SHA-256. The source_url identifies the acquisition manifest, not a publicly hosted ZIP. Reopen direct image URLs only if source reacquisition is needed. No whole-book PDF was acquired or hashed.

Selected facsimile only. Calendar headings and bounded Ordinary/Canon/colophon loci inspected; several leaves have actual text loss. Complete-volume acquisition, complete text, physical-copy completeness, textual recension and local reception remain unproved.

inspected_loci.subject: Calendar
inspected_loci.finding: Twelve consecutive monthly pages January-December; labels 1r-6v. January and December read at full displayed size; all twelve month headings and physical page structure inspected on the contact sheet. Calendar contents/ranks were not fully transcribed or collated.

inspected_loci.subject: Minor blessing of water
inspected_loci.finding: Exorcismus salis / Exorcismus aque at 21; Benedictio aque and Asperges with further prayers at 22. These intervene between December and the Temporale.

inspected_loci.subject: Local-use incipit and Temporale opening
inspected_loci.finding: Surviving incipit names the use of the insignis ecclesia Leodiensis; Dominica prima adventus and Ad te levavi follow. The adjacent bene correctum et emendatum claim is the printer/publisher's assertion, not an independently established revision.

inspected_loci.subject: Ordinary before the prefaces
inspected_loci.finding: 330 remains in common orations. Kyrie/Gloria chant begins low on 331 (printed f.155r), followed by Gloria/Creed at 332 and offertory rubrics/prayers at 333 (printed f.156r). 334 continues offertory/Orate pro me/secret instructions and begins the Nativity preface. This is not a single modern Ordo block isolated from the prefaces.

inspected_loci.subject: Canon and transition to Common
inspected_loci.finding: 359 ends the Holy Cross preface/Sanctus; 360 is the Crucifixion image. 361 begins Canon/Te igitur (printed f.170r; BSB label 177r), and 361-366 were visually inspected throughout. 366 ends with concluding Mass prayers, blessing and In principio instruction. 367 begins Commune apostolorum (reset printed f.1r). Visible lower-edge text loss in the Canon prevents a completeness claim.

inspected_loci.subject: Preparation and accidents of Mass
inspected_loci.finding: 392 is still Common of virgins; 393 ends Commune sanctorum in the left column and starts Preparatio ad missam in the right (printed f.14r). 396 holds associated prayers; 397-398 contain Accidentia misse (printed f.16r-16v). 399 begins the sanctoral at the vigil of St Andrew. Interior 394-395 were not acquired or read.

inspected_loci.subject: Colophon and end material
inspected_loci.finding: 553 colophon visually establishes Paris/Johannes Higman/1499-11-24. 554 is blank with library stamp and 556 is a blank support/end leaf. No assertion about all end leaves.

defects_and_limits.library_reported: Copy record M-437,1: leaf 1 (a1) missing; leaf 274 (K6) pasted onto a bound-in leaf; small text loss at leaves 169 (X1), 177 (X9), 178 (X10), 180 (X12). These are the library's bibliographical leaf references and have not been silently equated with current pencil/IIIF leaf labels.
defects_and_limits.image_observed: January is signed a.ii; repaired edges, staining and losses are visible. Lower text is lost on images 332, 362, 363, 365 and 366; Canon losses include the lower Memento and communion-prayer area. This is a damaged copy, with complete calendar month sequence visible but no complete-book claim.
defects_and_limits.evidence_ceiling: Selected original images directly verify the named use, place, completion date and identified structural boundaries. No complete transcription, full-book collation, actual diocesan reception, promulgation, or distinct recension is established. No edition-to-edition differences are proved.
defects_and_limits.source_date_bound: Retrieved 2026-10-21 UTC, during the 2026-10-20 America/Chicago research session.

retention_decision: Retain the 23.7 MB lossless 40-page project-created PDF, exact internal source-stream index, original IIIF metadata and offline rebuild recipe. Do not retain a duplicate source-JPEG ZIP in Git: exact byte recovery and deterministic ZIP reconstruction are verified. Modern wrapper HTML is restricted; small factual derivatives are retained.
remaining_gaps: Whole volume and whole-book PDF unacquired; first leaf a1 reported missing by the copy catalogue; no original title-page inspection claimed.
Damaged copy contains actual text losses; no complete Ordinary or complete liturgical-body transcription.
Other Liège candidates, edition-to-edition collation, substantive recension, approval and local reception remain open.
Calendar interior month headings inspected as a contact sheet; full feast/rank contents were not transcribed or collated.
Preparation interior images 394–395 not acquired or inspected.
limitations: Selected original images directly verify the named use, place, completion date and identified structural boundaries.
